author: BaluShredYou
quote: 13 years of waiting for this? Honestly, I’m extremely disappointed. After all this time, I expected something truly revolutionary, but the result feels nowhere near the masterpiece people were promised. The hype seems bigger than the actual quality of the game. It also feels like the reviews are giving it way more credit than it deserves. Rockstar had over a decade to deliver something extraordinary, and this simply doesn’t live up to my expectations. A huge disappointment.

author: BaluShredYou
quote: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time is a timeless masterpiece that still holds up incredibly well. The world is full of charm, secrets and memorable moments. Exploring Hyrule, solving dungeons and discovering new areas is just as enjoyable today as it was back then. The music is iconic, the atmosphere is fantastic and the gameplay is rewarding. Some mechanics feel a little dated, but overall, this is an unforgettable adventure every gamer should experience.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time (1998)
